context:
Goal: every simulator boot that shows a blank or black first screen is caught before a lane relies on it.
Problem (rule): decision sim-boot-is-verified says "A boot by `bin/sim-test` is not checked", and a recorded decision changes only on your word.
Based on (ruling): sim-boot-is-verified decides that a boot by bin/sim-test is not checked. Asked again because the outcome it rested on, the crash-loop stop (sim-test-stops-a-crash-loop) catching a black screen with no crash, is unmeasured, and a hook-only check misses most boots.
Based on (read): sim-test is the main boot path, so a check in the boot hook alone leaves most boots unchecked; today the hook judges only the screenshot's exit code (hooks/sim_boot_record.py sim_ok).
Departs from: main, where a sim-test boot gets no screen check — sim-test runs the same first-screen check after its own boot, and on a fail exits 1 and shuts down what it booted.
Meanwhile: the lane builds the boot hook's screen check, which does not depend on this answer.

options.gain: Every boot is checked, from one PR.
options.how: The lane adds the same screen check to sim-test and rewrites that line of the decision.
options.label: Check sim-test boots, in this lane
options.lose: A wider PR, so its review rounds cover sim-test too.

options.how: This lane ships the hook check only; a new step adds sim-test after it.
options.label: Check sim-test boots, in a later step
options.lose: sim-test boots stay unchecked until the second PR lands.

options.how: The decision line stays as written.
options.label: Leave sim-test boots unchecked
options.lose: Most boots stay unchecked, as with Home PR 576, whose screens were never checked on a device.

ref: decision sim-boot-is-verified; step sim-boot-screen-check; Home hand-off ask-mw839r77zp
reply: 12:02 CST Nov 8: a, routed to lane sim-boot-screen-check. sim-test boots get the same first-screen check, in this lane. A real Duo screenshot through the check is still owed on your Mac.
short: Check sim-test boots for a blank screen?
title: Should simulator boots by sim-test also be checked for a blank or black first screen?
